sources.defaultVenue: Severance Library, 5 Timber Ridge Parkway, Severance
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. The events page is a Communico embed (page config: apiServer https://api.communico.co, showRSS/showICAL true, locations []); events render client-side, and individual events live at clearview.libnet.info/event/<id>. Public feed attempts all redirected to the HTML events page: https://clearview.libnet.info/events/feed/ical, .../events/feed/rss, .../events/upcoming/feed/ical. The home page's upcoming list showed Windsor and Severance programs side by side (Babies and Books, Stay and Play, PAWS for Reading, Teen Dungeons & Dragons, 'Read, Rhyme, and Romp — Severance Library'), so a location filter on 'Severance Library' is needed. No feed read; check the page by hand or revisit for a Communico feed URL. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own). Feed found and read on 10 November 2026 by the sources agent. The Communico events page builds its iCal link in script (js/am-events-listings.js, _getFeed): /feeds?data= followed by the base64 of {"feedType":"ical","filters":{"location":["all"],"ages":["all"],"types":["all"],"tags":[],"term":"","days":1}}; that is the feedUrl, the same link the page's iCal button hands a reader (feedType rss gives the same items as RSS, without elements the repo's RSS reader knows). It answered 200 text/calendar: 319 VEVENTs, none recurring, 10 November 2026 to 29 January 2027, America/Denver, UID the event number (clearview.libnet.info/event/<UID>), LOCATION "<branch> - <room>". In the next 30 days (to 10 December) 184 items: 62 Bookmobile stops (LOCATION "Bookmobile - "), 69 at Windsor Library, 53 at Severance Library. clearview.libnet.info/robots.txt disallows only /results* and /sitesearch*, so the feed path is allowed. One feed serves both towns; each entry keeps its branch with locationFilter, and the bookmobile stops match neither. This entry is the Severance branch: 53 items in the next 30 days, 5 once the regulars are excluded by title (the same first-pass list as the Windsor entry, clearview-libnet-info: storytimes, Stay and Play, PAWS for Reading, Lego sessions, clubs, the homeschool academy, Dungeons & Dragons): Paper Roses (12 November), Gratitude Yoga (18 November), Teen DIY (1 December), Be Red Cross Ready (2 December), Holiday Concert & Cookie Exchange (9 December). Because this entry was already confirmed, the next ingest run will read the feed and stage the Severance Library's one-offs for review: set type back to html to stop that. Left as html on 10 November 2026 although the feed reads: the entry is already confirmed, so typing it ical would start ingest reading it before the owner has looked at the feed and its filters. sources.name: Weld RE-4 School District: Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. Weld RE-4 School District, 1020 Main St, Windsor, CO 80550, 970-686-8000 (page footer). The district calendar is a client-rendered grid backed by a public Google Calendar: id c_6rfdkemp84b7jsjvqjb5uk6q8c@group.calendar.google.com. Our robots-aware fetch reported that calendar.google.com/robots.txt disallows /calendar/ical/... for our agent, so the iCal was not read. The district site lists school sites gv, hl, mv, oh, rv, shs, sms, sv, tz (.weldre4.org) and a bond site. District-level calendar is mostly school-year dates; keep as a reference, not a weekly source. Feed read on 10 November 2026 by the sources agent, once, with a browser user agent: 200 text/calendar, calendar name "Weld RE-4 School District", 401 VEVENTs (13 recurring) from June 2022 to May 2028, 8 in the next 30 days, none of them an event (End of First Trimester, a Board of Education meeting, No School / Fall Break 23 to 27 November). Type changed from manual to ical so the feed is on record; still proposed, and still a reference for school-year dates rather than a source of listings. calendar.google.com/robots.txt is `Allow: /$` then `Disallow: /` for every agent, so under robots: honor ingest will not read this; it is a public calendar the school embeds on its own site, and robots: subscribe is the editor's call. The two high schools keep their own calendars (shs-weldre4-org, whs-weldre4-org), which is where the plays and concerts are.

sources.notes: Found on 10 November 2026 by the sources agent. The Windsor Downtown Alliance, a Downtown Development Authority (400 Main Street, Suite A, 970-451-6995, info@WindsorDDA.com), on a Munibit / MembershipWare site with Events and Calendar pages. Both are drawn in the browser by a script module (mwjsCalendar); the HTML carries no events and the module's code no iCal or RSS address, and /events/?ical=1, /events/feed/ and the Tribe REST path are the same page or 404. robots.txt is 404 (no rules). So nothing was counted: read it in a browser. The downtown events it promotes with the Windsor Main Street Partnership (the Blues & Brews Crawl in July, the Front Range Wine Festival in August, per search results, not read here) are the reason to keep it. The Town's own calendar has a Downtown Development Authority category (CID 41), empty on 10 November.
